title: New ERC4626YieldStrategy instances (ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2) and minterV2 are deployed without a pauser (setPauser never called) — net-new critical contracts left unpausable, no break-glass
description: MigrateSaga2Deploy deploys net-new ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2 and minterV2 but never calls setPauser, so they go live with pauser == address(0) and are unpausable. These contracts will hold all DOLA/USDC principal and the active phUSD mint authority. Verified NOT deferred-by-design: the downstream 2.2/2.3 scripts also never set the pauser. The prior batch-minter-migrate suppression (fingerprint b31f507a) does not carry — different entryPoint, net-new contracts, not deferred.
impact: No direct or standalone asset loss. Reduced incident-response capability (no break-glass / pause) on net-new contracts that hold principal and mint authority. Bites only if a separate future incident requires pausing. C4 Low/QA (operational-availability / configuration footgun, conditional-on-conditional).
attackPath: Script deploys ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2/minterV2 and never calls setPauser.
Contracts go live with pauser == address(0).
If a future incident requires pausing, no party can pause -> degraded response.
recommendation: Call setPauser (and register with the global Pauser) on each net-new strategy and minterV2 as a post-deploy step, with a post-condition assert that pauser() != address(0) and the contract is registered.

evidence.observed: Net-new contracts deployed with pauser == address(0); no setPauser in 2.1, 2.2, or 2.3.
evidence.suppressionBoundary: Prior b31f507a batch-minter-migrate carve-out does not apply (different entryPoint, net-new contracts, not deferred).

footgunRationale: Missing runbook step on net-new critical contracts. In scope (Law 3) as an operational-availability footgun with safe-config guidance (call setPauser post-deploy).
